ops.text: Adversarially verified at c152fbc6 (now origin/main): all 8 regression classes deny again; ~40 novel deny-path cases hold (bare/embedded/mixed command substitution, quoted glob/tilde/backslash, braces, backslash-newline via source.raw guard, emit_token emittable() gate).
